{{CharInfobox |color={{dragon color}} |corecolor={{dragon color light}} |bordercolor={{dragon color dark}} |name=Elder |jname=おばば様 |tmname=Matriarch |slogan=no |image=Elder BW anime art.png |size=100px |caption=Elder |colors=yes |eyes=Purple |hair=Gray |gender=Female |hometown=[[Village of Dragons]] |region=[[Unova]] |trainer=no |game=no |leader=no |team=no |brain=no |anime=yes |epnum=BW009 |epname=The Bloom Is on Axew! |java=[[Wasabi Mizuta]] |enva=[[Kayzie Rogers]] }} The '''elder''' (Japanese: '''おばば{{tt|様|さま}}''' ''matriarch'') of the [[Village of Dragons]] is a recurring character in {{aniseries|BW}}. She first appeared in ''[[BW009|The Bloom Is on Axew!]]''. ==In animation== [[File:Old woman BW009.png|thumb|left|250px|The elder in her home]] It was revealed in a flashback that she was the one who gave {{an|Iris}} her {{TP|Iris|Axew}}, with the intent of developing his skills in Pokémon battles. She believed that Iris had the skills necessary in order to raise Axew to one day become a strong {{p|Haxorus}}. The elder appeared in another one of Iris's flashbacks in ''[[BW027|The Dragon Master's Path!]]'', where she saw Iris off on her {{pkmn|journey}} to become a [[Type expert|Dragon Master]]. She told Iris that the journey would bring a lot of different experiences, both good and bad, but explained that these experiences would be important for the growth of her and Axew. In Iris's flashback in ''[[BW033|Iris and Excadrill Against the Dragon Buster!]]'', the elder witnessed Iris's battle against [[Drayden]] during the annual tournament in the Village of Dragons and seemed satisfied with her performance. It is unknown what type of connection she has with Drayden. [[File:Elder and Iris.png|thumb|right|250px|The Elder and Iris]] In ''[[BW056|The Lonely Deino!]]'', Iris mentioned that she helped a scared wild {{p|Druddigon}} that wandered into the Village of Dragons. The elder made a cameo appearance in ''[[M15|Kyurem VS. The Sword of Justice]]''. She was seen in a flashback telling Iris about {{p|Kyurem}}. The elder physically debuted in ''[[BW100|A Village Homecoming!]]'', when Ash and friends passed by the Village of Dragons. During this period, she was introduced to Ash and Cilan, and observed how Iris had been training her Axew. After Iris introduced her {{TP|Iris|Dragonite}} to her, the elder was forced to separate it from a Haxorus that was sleeping nearby. In [[BW101|the next episode]], she was seen in a flashback talking to Drayden about Iris's future, and how she can become a Gym Leader and Dragon Master. ===Character=== The elder is respected by her community for her knowledge of {{type|Dragon}} Pokémon. She evaluates partnerships between beginning Dragon Masters and their first Pokémon, which are typically given to the Trainer at a coming of age. Iris mentioned that the elder "does not like the cold", presumably similar to Iris's dislike of {{type|Ice}} Pokémon. ===Pokémon=== ====Given away==== {{TrainerPoké |main=yes |trainer=Iris |pkmn=Axew |egg=yes |gender=male |type1=Dragon |img=Iris Axew debut.png |epnum=BW001 |epname=In The Shadow of Zekrom! |vajp=Minami Tsuda |vaen=Kayzie Rogers |desc=In ''[[BW009|The Bloom Is on Axew!]]'', it was revealed that the elder gave {{an|Iris}} her {{p|Axew}} when he was just a day old.}} ===Voice actors=== {{vatable|color={{dragon color}}|bordercolor={{dragon color light}} |de=Dagmar Dempe |ja=水田わさび ''[[Wasabi Mizuta]]'' |en=[[Kayzie Rogers]] |fi=Unknown voice actress ([[BW009]])
